title: One line, two lanes
summary: How this layer runs through the method, set as type on one hairline: three phases hang from it, Handover is a datum, and Calibrate drops into two lanes — your operator, or us on retainer — that run off the edge of the page because they never end.
story: Answers “who keeps it running after handover?” for this layer. After the document (what you hold) comes its life: the narrative readout first, the matrix decided with your leadership, the system installed, handed over, then retuned each quarter — and you own it in both lanes.
copy: [N] h2 “From the readout to your operator.”
[N] the five phase outputs (Diagnose · Architect · Install · Handover · Calibrate) for this layer

[N] (FC scope) lanes: Your operator — “Edits the Narrative OS as the market argues back; writes new segments and launches inside the system.” · With us on retainer — “We write and ship the next version, and keep the objection answers current.”
[N] “Who owns it · You, in both lanes.”
phone: ≤1023 (and ≤767): the track turns vertical — one spine down the left with each phase hanging off a short tick; Handover becomes a rule across with its hollow node; Calibrate's two lanes stack under it (solid, then dotted), nothing bleeds; ‘Who owns it’ and the method link follow. ≤767 sets it tighter (names 18px, shorter gaps).

reference.site: Approved homepage method/U (the Handover datum and the dotted ‘With us on retainer’ lane), set without bars
reference.borrowed: The method's vocabulary only: four phases, Handover as the datum, a dotted retainer lane.
reference.kelwin: Typographic, not a gantt: no bars, no plate, one hairline that bleeds off the page; the Calibrate tick becomes a stem that forks into two lanes, so ‘run by your operator or with us on retainer’ is drawn as a choice, not a sentence.

motion: entrance (the page's second body moment, plays once): the hairline draws left to right to the page edge (1.4s); the phases hang from it one by one (180ms apart); the Handover datum drops with its node; Calibrate's stem drops through both lanes and they run out to the edge, solid then dotted; ‘Who owns it’ and the method link fade in under ‘Runs once’.
on the live site: plays once when the section scrolls into view. Reduced motion: final state.
